name: spreadsheets
description: XLSX spreadsheet production skills and an Excel viewer panel, published as an official CodeFusion plugin.

description_i18n.en: Spreadsheet skills for XLSX: create, edit, analyze, chart, and convert workbooks. View workbooks in a side panel: reference cells in chat, and the agent can read, search, point at and capture them.
description_i18n.zh-CN: XLSX spreadsheet skill: creation, editing, analysis, charting, and format conversion. View workbooks in the sidebar and reference cells in chat, where the Agent can read, search, locate, highlight, and capture screenshots.
